title: DQM-ML Job Configuration
description: Root configuration for a dqm-ml job. Each field maps to a pipeline stage.

ColumnDistributionParams.title: ColumnDistributionParams
ColumnDistributionParams.description: Per-column distribution parameters for user_provided mean_std_estimation.

ColumnRename.title: ColumnRename
ColumnRename.description: Mapping from an original column name to a new name.

ColumnsConfig.title: ColumnsConfig
ColumnsConfig.description: Column selection, exclusion, renaming, and prefix/suffix operations.

input.title: Input
input.description: Columns to read (fnmatch patterns supported). None reads all.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Prefix prepended to each column name.

suffix.title: Suffix
suffix.description: Suffix appended to each column name.

CompletenessProcessorConfig.title: CompletenessProcessorConfig
CompletenessProcessorConfig.description: Configuration for completeness metric computation. Computes per-column and overall completeness (non-null) metrics. Attributes: type: Processor type discriminator ("completeness"). include_per_column: Include per-column completeness scores in output. include_overall: Include overall completeness score in output. include_metadata: Include metadata (total rows, null counts) in output.

device.title: Device
device.description: Compute device: 'auto' picks cuda if available.

DataLoaderConfig.title: DataLoaderConfig
DataLoaderConfig.description: Configuration for a single dataloader (Parquet or CSV).

path.title: Path
path.description: Glob pattern or path to data files.

DataLoadersConfig.title: DataLoadersConfig
DataLoadersConfig.description: Collection of dataloaders for a job.

storage.description: Default storage config inherited by all loaders.

DistanceConfig.title: DistanceConfig
DistanceConfig.description: Distance metric configuration for domain-gap computation. Attributes: metric: Distance metric name (e.g., "mmd", "discriminative", "klmvn_diag"). evaluator: Optional evaluator type for discriminative metrics. k: Number of nearest neighbours (for k-NN based metrics). feature_weights: Per-feature weights for weighted distance computation. kernel_params: Kernel parameters (RBF or Polynomial) for kernel-based metrics. epsilon: Regularization epsilon for numerical stability of covariance-based metrics. klmvn_var_eps: Variance regularization for KL divergence numerical stability.

epsilon.title: Epsilon
epsilon.description: Regularization epsilon for numerical stability of covariance-based metrics (e.g. FID).

feature_weights.title: Feature Weights
feature_weights.description: Per-feature weights for weighted distance computation.

klmvn_var_eps.title: Klmvn Var Eps
klmvn_var_eps.description: Variance regularization for klmvn_diag numerical stability (default 0.0). When > 0, source and target variances are replaced by var + klmvn_var_eps * mean(var) before computing KL divergence, preventing blow-up from near-zero variance dimensions.

DiversityProcessorConfig.title: DiversityProcessorConfig
DiversityProcessorConfig.description: Configuration for diversity metric computation. Computes diversity metrics: Simpson, Gini, Shannon entropy, and richness. Attributes: type: Processor type discriminator ("diversity"). metrics: List of diversity metrics to compute.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: List of diversity metrics to compute.

DomainGapProcessorConfig.title: DomainGapProcessorConfig
DomainGapProcessorConfig.description: Configuration for domain-gap (distribution shift) measurement. Measures distribution shift between datasets using a configured distance metric. Attributes: type: Processor type discriminator ("domain_gap"). columns: Column input configuration (required). distance: Distance metric configuration. summary: Embedding summary configuration.

default.title: Default
default.description: Default error action when no specific policy is set.

max_failure_rate.title: Max Failure Rate
max_failure_rate.description: Maximum tolerated failure rate before the job aborts (from 0.0 to 1.0).

FeaturesEmbeddingsProcessorConfig.title: FeaturesEmbeddingsProcessorConfig
FeaturesEmbeddingsProcessorConfig.description: Configuration for neural-network embedding feature extraction. Extracts deep learning embeddings from images using a configured model. Attributes: type: Processor type discriminator ("features_embeddings"). model: Neural network model configuration. infer: Inference pre-processing settings.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Feature columns to exclude (fnmatch patterns supported).

include.title: Include
include.description: Feature columns to include (fnmatch patterns supported).

FilterConfig.title: FilterConfig
FilterConfig.description: Row-level filter applied during data loading.

values.title: Values
values.description: Value(s) to keep. Rows where column matches are included.

GrteConfig.title: GrteConfig
GrteConfig.description: Gini-ratio-threshold-entropy (GRTE) configuration for representativeness. Attributes: threshold: Gini ratio threshold for flagging. scaling_factor: Scaling applied to the Gini ratio (negative inverts).

scaling_factor.title: Scaling Factor
scaling_factor.description: Scaling applied to the Gini ratio.

HistogramConfig.title: HistogramConfig
HistogramConfig.description: Histogram parameters for feature extraction. Attributes: bins: Number of histogram bins (must be positive).

HistogramSummaryConfig.title: HistogramSummaryConfig
HistogramSummaryConfig.description: Histogram settings for embedding summary statistics. Attributes: dims: Number of dimensions to histogram. bins: Number of bins per dimension (must be positive). range: Histogram range [min, max] for each dimension.

HistogramsConfig.title: HistogramsConfig
HistogramsConfig.description: Histogram parameters for representativeness evaluation. Attributes: bins: Number of histogram bins (must be positive).

on_decode_failure.title: On Decode Failure
on_decode_failure.description: Action when an image cannot be decoded.

on_transform_error.title: On Transform Error
on_transform_error.description: Action when an image transform fails.

ImageFeaturesProcessorConfig.title: ImageFeaturesProcessorConfig
ImageFeaturesProcessorConfig.description: Configuration for low-level image feature extraction. Extracts luminosity, contrast, blur, and entropy features from images. Attributes: type: Processor type discriminator ("image_features"). features: List of image features to compute. batch_size: Batch size for image processing. grayscale: Whether to convert images to grayscale. normalize: Whether to normalize pixel values to [0, 1]. laplacian_kernel: Laplacian kernel size for blur detection ("3x3" or "5x5"). clip_percentiles: Percentile clipping for extreme pixel values, e.g. (1, 99). histogram: Histogram configuration for feature computation. luminosity_weights: Luminosity weights for grayscale conversion. Standard name ('bt601', 'bt709', 'bt2020') or [R, G, B] list/tuple. Defaults to BT.709 when None.

clip_percentiles.title: Clip Percentiles
clip_percentiles.description: Percentile clipping for extreme pixel values, e.g. (1, 99).

features.title: Features
features.description: List of image features to compute.

laplacian_kernel.title: Laplacian Kernel
laplacian_kernel.description: Laplacian kernel size for blur detection.

luminosity_weights.title: Luminosity Weights
luminosity_weights.description: Luminosity weights for grayscale conversion. Standard name ('bt601', 'bt709', 'bt2020') or [R, G, B] list. Defaults to BT.709 when None.

InferConfig.title: InferConfig
InferConfig.description: Inference pre-processing settings for image embeddings. Attributes: batch_size: Inference batch size. width: Resize width for input images. height: Resize height for input images. norm_mean: Per-channel mean used for normalisation (ImageNet defaults). norm_std: Per-channel std used for normalisation (ImageNet defaults).

InterpretationConfig.title: InterpretationConfig
InterpretationConfig.description: Human-readable labels for representativeness and diversity results. Attributes: follows_distribution: Label when data follows the expected distribution. does_not_follow_distribution: Label when data diverges from expected distribution. high_diversity: Label for high diversity results. low_diversity: Label for low diversity results. high_representativeness: Label for high representativeness results. low_representativeness: Label for low representativeness results.

follows_distribution.title: Follows Distribution
follows_distribution.description: Label when data follows the distribution.

KernelParamsPoly.title: KernelParamsPoly
KernelParamsPoly.description: Polynomial kernel parameters for distance metrics. Attributes: degree: Polynomial degree. gamma: Polynomial kernel gamma parameter. coefficient0: Polynomial kernel coefficient offset (constant term).

KernelParamsRbf.title: KernelParamsRbf
KernelParamsRbf.description: RBF (Radial Basis Function) kernel parameters for distance metrics. Attributes: gamma: RBF kernel gamma parameter (inverse kernel width).

KsConfig.title: KsConfig
KsConfig.description: Kolmogorov-Smirnov test configuration for representativeness. Attributes: sample_size: Number of samples for KS testing. min_sample_size: Minimum samples required for KS test. sample_divisor: Divisor for automatic sample-size calculation.

min_sample_size.title: Min Sample Size
min_sample_size.description: Minimum samples required for KS test.

sample_size.title: Sample Size
sample_size.description: Number of samples for KS testing.

ModelConfig.title: ModelConfig
ModelConfig.description: Neural network model configuration for embedding extraction. Attributes: arch: Model architecture name (e.g., "resnet18", "resnet50"). n_layer_feature: Layer index (negative for reverse) or list of layer names for feature extraction. Default -2 (second to last layer). device: Device for model inference ("auto", "cpu", "cuda").

n_layer_feature.title: N Layer Feature
n_layer_feature.description: Layer index or list of layer names for feature extraction.

RepresentativenessProcessorConfig.title: RepresentativenessProcessorConfig
RepresentativenessProcessorConfig.description: Configuration for representativeness evaluation against a reference distribution. Evaluates how well a dataset represents a target distribution using multiple statistical metrics. Attributes: type: Processor type discriminator ("representativeness"). metrics: List of representativeness metrics to compute. alpha: Significance level for statistical tests. epsilon: Small constant to avoid division by zero. distribution: Expected reference distribution ("normal" or "uniform"). interpretation: Human-readable labels for results. histogram: Histogram configuration for evaluation. shannon: Shannon entropy threshold configuration. grte: GRTE configuration. ks: Kolmogorov-Smirnov test configuration.

distribution_params.title: Distribution Params
distribution_params.description: Per-column explicit distribution parameters for 'user_provided' strategy. Example: [{'column': 'col1', 'mean': 0.0, 'std': 1.0}]

epsilon.title: Epsilon
epsilon.description: Small constant to avoid division by zero.

expected_counts_method.title: Expected Counts Method
expected_counts_method.description: Method for computing expected bin counts. 'cdf' — exact expected counts via CDF (deterministic). 'monte_carlo' — Monte Carlo sampling via RNG (stochastic).

mean_std_estimation.title: Mean Std Estimation
mean_std_estimation.description: How distribution parameters (mean/std for normal, min/max for uniform) are estimated. 'from_first_batch' — estimate from the first batch and reuse (consistent with bin edges). 'per_batch' — re-estimate on each batch (use with high-variance data, risks insufficient_bins). 'user_provided' — use explicit parameters from distribution_params. 'from_all_data' — estimate from full dataset (not yet implemented).

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: List of representativeness metrics to compute.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Retry mode: 'default' uses exponential backoff, 'standard' uses fixed intervals.

column.title: Column
column.description: Column name containing relative file paths.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Base directory for resolving relative paths.

ShannonConfig.title: ShannonConfig
ShannonConfig.description: Shannon-entropy threshold configuration for representativeness. Attributes: threshold: Entropy threshold for flagging under-represented values.

SplitConfig.title: SplitConfig
SplitConfig.description: How to split data into named groups (e.g. train / test).

by.title: By
by.description: Column used to determine the split group.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Split-group values to exclude (fnmatch patterns supported).

values.title: Values
values.description: Explicit list of split-group values to materialise. Auto-discovered if None.

proxy_options.title: Proxy Options
proxy_options.description: Proxy configuration as a dict or URL string.

role_arn.title: Role Arn
role_arn.description: ARN of IAM role to assume.

session_name.title: Session Name
session_name.description: Name for the assumed role session.

tls_ca_file_path.title: Tls Ca File Path
tls_ca_file_path.description: Path to a custom TLS CA bundle.

SummaryConfig.title: SummaryConfig
SummaryConfig.description: Embedding summary configuration for domain-gap computation. Attributes: collect_sum_outer: Collect sum-of-outer-products for covariance estimation. store_embeddings: Store full embedding vectors in output. histogram: Histogram configuration for embedding summaries.

on_file_not_found.title: On File Not Found
on_file_not_found.description: Action when a data file is not found.

on_missing_column.title: On Missing Column
on_missing_column.description: Action when a required column is missing.

in_place.title: In Place
in_place.description: Overwrite the original column in place.

TransformType.title: TransformType
TransformType.description: Target data type for column transformations.
